sections.Aims and Fit of Module: This module aims to aims to provide content explanations on Marxist views on nature, Marxist views on science and technology, Marxist social theory of science and technology, and Chinese Marxist views on science and technology, so as to cultivate graduate students' theoretical thinking ability, and at the same time guide students to establish a sense of serving the country and cultivate the ability to innovate. The course takes "participation-interaction-ability-value" as its teaching concept, strengthens participation, and through interaction, stimulates and enhances innovation ability and shapes value. 《自然辩证法概论》旨在提供马克思主义自然观、马克思主义科学技术观、马克思主义科学技术社会论、中国马克思主义科学技术观的内容讲解，以培养研究生理论思维能力，同时引导学生树立服务于国家的意识并培养守正创新能力。 课程以“参与-互动-能力-价值”为教学理念，强化参与，通过互动，激励并提升创新能力，塑造价值。
sections.Learning outcomes: A Have a clear understanding of the significance and value of the country's major scientific and technological strategies. 对国家重大科技战略意义与价值有明确的认知 B Be able to identify problematic innovations. 能够识别有问题的创新。 C Be able to use dialectical thinking ability to correctly analyze and solve problems encountered in innovation, and propose and demonstrate solutions. 能够运用辩证思维能力正确地分析和解决创新所遇到的问题，提出并论证解决方案。
sections.Method of teaching and learning: This module is conducted both online and offline. The online course is on the MOOC platform and delivered by Zhejiang University. Four offline sessions will be conducted during the first academic year: two at SIP and two at the XEC. Students may choose which offline sessions to attend based on their location. Students must complete the course and pass the assessment by the end of the first academic year. Online quiz after lectures will be carried out to evaluate students’ progress and achievement of the learning outcomes. Students will have 2 opportunities to take the quiz, and the higher score will be used for grading. To pass the assessment, students must meet the following three requirements: 1. Watch at least 26 hours of the online course. 2. Participate in two offline sessions. 3. Score at least 50% on the final quiz. 该课程提供线上和线下两种教学模式。线上课程通过中国大学MOOC平台进行，是由浙江大学马克思主义学院教师录制的精品课程。该课程开展四次线下课，其中园区校区开展两次，太仓校区开展两次，学生可根据所在校区进行线下课程学习。学生需在校期间第一个学年结束前完成所有课程学习，并进行Quiz答题（两次机会，取高分进行记分），已检验学习效果。本课程旨在引导学生深入理解习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想的主要内容和科学体系，适合各类学习需求和时间安排。 通过课程需要满足下列3个要求： 1.线上课程学习时长达到至少26小时； 2.参与两次线下课程并完成签到； 3.期末线上考试达到50分以上。
